notes: Repo's %_identify_content_or_server macro, copied verbatim from the SAS Studio custom step. It classifies a path by scheme prefix via SCAN(...,1,":","MO") in a DATA step + CALL SYMPUT. Original relies on no Viya services, so it runs stand-alone; a small caller drives it over three mock path references (sascontent:, sasserver:, and a bare path).
